1.w: Give thanks to YHWH, for [He is] good, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

2.w: Give thanks to the God of gods, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

3.w: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

4.w: to the One doing great wonders by Himself alone, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

5.w: to the One making the heavens with understanding, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

6.w: to the One spreading out the earth upon the waters, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

7.w: to the One making great the lights—for His loving devotion [is] forever—

8.w: the sun for ruling over the day, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

9.w: the moon and stars for ruling over the night, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

10.w: to the one striking Egypt, against their firstborn, for His loving devotion [is] forever.

11.w: And He brought forth Israel from their midst, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

12.w: with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

13.w: to the One dividing the Red sea into parts, for His loving devotion [is] forever.

14.w: And He made Israel pass through the midst of it, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

15.w: and He shook off Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

16.w: to the One leading His people through the wilderness, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

17.w: to the One striking great kings, for His loving devotion [is] forever.

18.w: And He killed mighty kings, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

19.w: Sihon king of the Amorite, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

20.w: and Og king of Bashan, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

21.w: and He gave their land as an inheritance—for His loving devotion [is] forever;

22.w: an inheritance to Israel His servant, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

23.w: who in our lowliness remembered us, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

24.w: and rescued us from our enemies, for His loving devotion [is] forever;

25.w: the One giving food to all flesh, for His loving devotion [is] forever.

26.w: Give thanks to the God of the heavens, for His loving devotion [is] forever!
